rationale: Typed ode_system contract preserved verbatim: three states (v, brake_temperature, cart_position) with the given RHS; benchmark output is dv_dt of the v-equation. Parameter values chosen at realistic physical magnitudes for a ~100 kg cart at v0=20 m/s: quadratic drag ~1.3 m/s^2 at launch, rolling drag ~0.1 m/s^2, track slope forcing ~0.2 m/s^2, giving a smooth decay over ~30 s. Headwind parameters (amplitude 3 m/s, wavenumber 0.1 1/m, phase 0.5) sit inside the suggested ranges and produce a ~30x sigma signature of the new (v+w)|v+w| coupling relative to the parent v|v| term. Noise sigma=0.02 m/s^2 is small vs the dominant terms yet coarse enough to be a meaningful visibility yardstick. 300 uniform time points over [0,30] resolves both the low-frequency decay and the position-driven ripples (a few wavelengths of both track and headwind).
